required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 31 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Were startup commands recorded before project gates?
Was startup-snapshot the first project gate?
Did decision metadata remain valid and approved?
Was this rework decision treated as current authority and `task_packet.json` as background only?
Were changes limited to allowed source/test/workflow/artifact files?
Did the report clearly identify the previous bridge round as `REWORK_REQUIRED` rather than accepted?
Was `ci_observation_reconcile_result.json` regenerated with current decision ID, round ID, and report ID?
Does `ci_observation_reconcile_result.json` accurately classify reconcile state when execution-log or other diagnostic sources are not final?
Does `ci_observation_reconcile_result.json` avoid plain `RECONCILED` when any required source is failed or stale?
Was `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` regenerated with current decision ID, round ID, and report ID?
Does `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` reflect final post-closeout `final_gate_result.json` status?
Does `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` reflect final post-closeout `run_closeout_result.json` and close-round status?
Does `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` avoid stale `final_check: FAILED` while claiming `READY_FOR_AUDIT`?
Does `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` avoid stale `run_closeout: IN_PROGRESS` while claiming `READY_FOR_AUDIT`?
Does `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` avoid unresolved `pending_diagnostic_sources` when report status is `SUCCESS` and recommendation is `ACCEPTED`?
Did final-check add or enforce a hard check for stale bundle/reconcile internal status?
Did final-check fail in tests or fixtures when bundle final_check/run_closeout states are stale?
Did report-summary include the corrected reconcile and audit handoff bundle statuses?
Did execution-log align with command-plan and pytest_result, or was any diagnostic gap explicitly non-final before closeout?
Did `ci_run_evidence_result.json` remain current and honest about live observation state?
Did `local_ci_parity_result.json` remain current with no required parity gaps?
Did `ci_workflow_coverage_result.json` remain current and complete?
Did `ci_workflow_readiness_result.json` remain current and READY?
Did local execution bundle remain valid?
Did codex prompt packet remain valid?
Did audit precheck remain valid?
Did audit readiness become ready and accepted after closeout?
Did final-check pass only after the corrected bundle/reconcile state was produced?
Did run-closeout pass and close-round close?
Did Required Audit answers cite direct artifact evidence rather than using `ci_audit_handoff_bundle.json` as a generic substitute for all claims?
Did this round avoid remote CI dispatch/poll/repository mutation and stay within closeout consistency rework?
